name: Agent log tail
description: Shows the last lines of the agent log: journald unit ulrmm-agent, else a log file under /opt/ulrmm-agent or /var/log, else syslog. Exit 3 when none exists.

name: Agent services status
description: Shows install, enable and run state of the agent and the MeshCentral agent (systemd or OpenRC) and the agent version. Exit 1 when the agent is not running.

name: ClamAV install
description: Installs ClamAV and freshclam with the system package manager, enables automatic signature updates and loads the signatures.

variables.name: ENABLE_EPEL
variables.label: Add EPEL on RHEL family
variables.help: ClamAV comes from EPEL on RHEL, AlmaLinux and Rocky Linux.

name: ClamAV scan
description: Scans the given paths with clamscan and lists infected files without changing them. Exit 1 on infection, 2 on scan errors.

variables.name: PATHS
variables.label: Paths to scan
variables.help: Absolute paths, comma or newline separated.

variables.name: EXCLUDE
variables.label: Paths to skip
variables.help: Absolute paths, comma or newline separated. /proc, /sys, /dev and /run are always skipped.

variables.name: MAX_FILESIZE_MB
variables.label: Skip files larger than (MB)
variables.help: Larger files are not scanned.

name: ClamAV signature update
description: Runs freshclam now, pausing the freshclam service for the run. Exit 1 when the update fails.

name: ClamAV status
description: Checks that ClamAV is installed, how old the signatures are and whether automatic updates run.

variables.name: WARN_DAYS
variables.label: Warn at signature age (days)
variables.help: Signature age that counts as a warning.

variables.name: FAIL_DAYS
variables.label: Fail at signature age (days)
variables.help: Signature age that fails the check.

name: ESET Endpoint Antivirus for Linux - install
description: Installs ESET Endpoint Antivirus for Linux from your hosted .bin after a sha256 check, with the documented -y -f switches, and activates it.

variables.name: INSTALLER_URL
variables.label: Installer URL
variables.help: https URL of eeau.x86_64.bin from ESET's download page.

variables.name: INSTALLER_SHA256
variables.label: Installer sha256
variables.help: sha256sum of the .bin; the installer is not run when it differs.

variables.name: LICENSE_KEY
variables.label: License key
variables.help: ESET license key for lic -k, never printed. Empty leaves activation to ESET PROTECT.

name: ESET Server Security for Linux - install
description: Installs ESET Server Security for Linux from ESET's .bin after a sha256 check and activates it with the license key if given.

variables.name: INSTALLER_URL
variables.label: Installer URL
variables.help: https URL of efs.x86_64.bin. Empty uses ESET's latest download.

variables.name: INSTALLER_SHA256
variables.label: Installer sha256
variables.help: sha256sum of the .bin; the installer is not run when it differs.

variables.name: LICENSE_KEY
variables.label: License key
variables.help: ESET license key for lic -k, never printed. Empty leaves activation to ESET PROTECT.

name: Hardware identity collector
description: Reads vendor, model and serial from sysfs DMI, dmidecode or the device tree. The last line is the serial number; exit 3 when the system has none.

name: Kernel report
description: Shows the running kernel, installed kernels, kernel packages and whether a newer one needs a reboot. Read only.

name: Listening ports report
description: Lists listening TCP and UDP sockets with the owning process (ss, netstat, or /proc without process names). Read only.

name: Logged-in users report
description: Lists current logins, systemd sessions and the last ten logins. Read only.

name: Scheduled jobs report
description: Lists system and per-user crontabs, cron.d, periodic directories, systemd timers and at jobs. Read only.

name: System report
description: Prints distribution, kernel, uptime, virtualization, CPU, memory, disks, filesystems, addresses, default route, package managers, service manager and pending reboot. Read only.

name: Container prune
description: Removes stopped containers, dangling images and unused networks of docker or podman and reports the space before and after. Dry run by default.

variables.name: DRY_RUN
variables.label: Dry run
variables.help: Only list what would be removed.

variables.name: ALL_IMAGES
variables.label: All unused images
variables.help: Also remove tagged images no container uses.

variables.name: VOLUMES
variables.label: Unused volumes
variables.help: Also remove volumes no container uses (data is lost).

name: Filesystem trim
description: Runs fstrim on all mounted filesystems that support it. Exit 3 in containers or when fstrim is missing.

name: Journal vacuum
description: Shrinks the systemd journal to a size and optionally an age limit. Exit 3 on systems without a systemd journal.

variables.name: MAX_SIZE_MB
variables.label: Keep at most (MB)
variables.help: Journal is trimmed to this size.

variables.name: MAX_AGE_DAYS
variables.label: Keep at most (days)
variables.help: Optional, also drops entries older than this.

name: Package cache clean
description: Clears the package manager cache (apt, dnf, yum, zypper, pacman, apk) and reports the space freed. Exit 1 when cleaning fails, 3 without a package manager.

name: Remove unused packages
description: Removes packages nothing depends on any more (apt, dnf, yum, zypper, pacman) and never the running kernel. Dry run by default. Alpine has nothing to remove.

variables.name: DRY_RUN
variables.label: Dry run
variables.help: Only list what would be removed.

name: Service control
description: Shows, starts, stops, restarts, enables or disables one service on systemd or OpenRC. Exit 1 when the service is not in the requested state. The agent services are protected, network services cannot be stopped or disabled.

variables.name: SERVICE
variables.label: Service
variables.help: Unit or init script name, for example nginx or sshd.

name: Temporary files clean
description: Deletes files in /tmp and /var/tmp that were neither modified, read nor changed for the given number of days; files held open by a process are kept. Dry run by default.

variables.name: DRY_RUN
variables.label: Dry run
variables.help: Only list what would be removed.

variables.name: MAX_AGE_DAYS
variables.label: Older than (days)
variables.help: Files untouched for this long are removed.

name: Certificate expiry check
description: Checks expiry of PEM certificate files and TLS endpoints (host:port) with openssl. Exit 2 inside the warning window, 1 when expired, unreachable or inside the error window.

variables.name: TARGETS
variables.label: Targets
variables.help: Absolute file path or host:port. One per line or comma separated.

variables.name: WARN_DAYS
variables.label: Warn days
variables.help: Days before expiry that count as a warning.

variables.name: ERROR_DAYS
variables.label: Error days
variables.help: Days before expiry that count as a failure.

name: Container health check
description: Finds unhealthy, restarting and non-zero-exited containers with docker or podman. Exit 1 when any is found, 3 without an engine or daemon.

variables.name: IGNORE
variables.label: Ignored containers
variables.help: Container names to skip. One per line or comma separated.

name: Disk space check
description: Checks used space on local filesystems (ext4, xfs, btrfs, zfs, vfat...) and skips tmpfs, overlay, squashfs and network mounts. Exit 2 at the warning level, 1 at the error level, 3 on bad input.

variables.name: WARN_PERCENT
variables.label: Warn at or above (%)
variables.help: Used space that counts as a warning.

variables.name: ERROR_PERCENT
variables.label: Error at or above (%)
variables.help: Used space that counts as a failure.

variables.name: EXCLUDE
variables.label: Excluded mount points
variables.help: Mount points to skip. One per line or comma separated.

name: Failed logins report
description: Counts failed SSH logins in the last hours from journald or auth.log/secure and lists the top source addresses. Exit 2 when the threshold is reached.

variables.name: THRESHOLD
variables.label: Warning threshold
variables.help: Number of failures that counts as a warning.

name: Failed services check
description: Lists failed systemd units or crashed OpenRC services. Exit 1 when any is found, 3 when neither systemd nor OpenRC is running.

variables.name: IGNORE
variables.label: Ignored services
variables.help: Service names to skip. One per line or comma separated.

name: Inode usage check
description: Checks inode usage on filesystems that have inode tables (ext4, xfs, f2fs, jfs...). Exit 2 at the warning level, 1 at the error level, 3 when no such filesystem exists.

variables.name: WARN_PERCENT
variables.label: Warn at or above (%)
variables.help: Used inodes that count as a warning.

variables.name: ERROR_PERCENT
variables.label: Error at or above (%)
variables.help: Used inodes that count as a failure.

variables.name: EXCLUDE
variables.label: Excluded mount points
variables.help: Mount points to skip. One per line or comma separated.

name: Journal errors report
description: Shows error-level log entries of the last hours from journald, or from /var/log/messages or syslog without journald. Exit 2 when any exist, 3 without a log source.

name: Listening port check
description: Checks that every listed port has a listener, read from /proc/net so no extra tool is needed. Exit 1 when a port is closed.

variables.name: PORTS
variables.label: Ports
variables.help: 1-65535, optionally tcp: or udp: prefixed (default tcp). One per line or comma separated.

name: Load check
description: Compares the 5-minute load average divided by the CPU core count with the thresholds. Exit 2 at the warning level, 1 at the error level.

variables.name: WARN_PER_CORE
variables.label: Warn per core
variables.help: 5-minute load per core that counts as a warning.

variables.name: ERROR_PER_CORE
variables.label: Error per core
variables.help: 5-minute load per core that counts as a failure.

name: Memory check
description: Compares used memory (total minus MemAvailable) with the thresholds and reports swap use. Exit 2 at the warning level, 1 at the error level.

variables.name: WARN_PERCENT
variables.label: Warn at or above (%)
variables.help: Used memory that counts as a warning.

variables.name: ERROR_PERCENT
variables.label: Error at or above (%)
variables.help: Used memory that counts as a failure.

name: Out-of-memory kills check
description: Looks for kernel out-of-memory kills in the last hours (journald, else the kernel ring buffer since boot or kern.log). Exit 1 when any are found.

name: Process running check
description: Checks that every listed process name is running, using the kernel process name (15 characters). Exit 1 when one is missing.

variables.name: PROCESSES
variables.label: Processes
variables.help: Process names such as nginx. One per line or comma separated.

name: Reboot required check
description: Detects a pending reboot: Debian/Ubuntu flag file, needs-restarting on RHEL and Fedora, zypper needs-rebooting on openSUSE, otherwise running versus newest installed kernel. Exit 2 when a reboot is needed.

name: Services running check
description: Checks that every listed service is active (systemd) or started (OpenRC). Exit 1 when one is not running.

variables.name: SERVICES
variables.label: Services
variables.help: Service names such as sshd or cron. One per line or comma separated.

name: Time sync check
description: Checks clock synchronisation with chrony, ntpd, systemd-timesyncd or busybox ntpd, whichever is present. Exit 1 when not synchronised, 3 when no tool exists.

name: Uptime check
description: Warns when the machine has been up longer than the limit, a hint for missed reboots after kernel updates. Exit 2 above the limit.

variables.name: MAX_DAYS
variables.label: Maximum uptime (days)
variables.help: Days of uptime that count as a warning.

name: URL check
description: Requests an http or https URL with curl or wget and compares the status code. Redirects are not followed with curl. Exit 1 on another status or no answer.

variables.name: URL
variables.label: URL
variables.help: http:// or https:// address.

variables.name: EXPECT_STATUS
variables.label: Expected status
variables.help: HTTP status code that counts as healthy.

variables.name: TIMEOUT
variables.label: Timeout (s)
variables.help: Seconds to wait, 1 to 300.

name: Connectivity test
description: Pings hosts, opens TCP connections to host:port targets and optionally resolves a name. Exit 1 when any test fails.

variables.name: TARGETS
variables.label: Targets
variables.help: host or host:port. One per line or comma separated.

variables.name: DNS_NAME
variables.label: DNS name to resolve
variables.help: Optional host name to look up.

name: DNS report
description: Shows resolver configuration (resolv.conf, systemd-resolved, nsswitch) and runs test lookups. Exit 1 when example.com cannot be resolved.

name: Interfaces and routes report
description: Lists interfaces with state, MTU, MAC and addresses plus IPv4 and IPv6 routes. Read only.

name: Restart or shut down
description: Schedules a restart or shutdown after a delay, or cancels a scheduled one. Logged-in users get the message.

variables.name: MESSAGE
variables.label: Message
variables.help: Optional notice for logged-in users.

name: Wake-on-LAN
description: Shows or enables magic packet wake on a wired interface and makes it persistent through NetworkManager or systemd-networkd; says so when it cannot be persistent (for example under netplan). Exit 3 without hardware support.

variables.name: INTERFACE
variables.label: Interface
variables.help: Optional, default is the first physical wired interface.

name: SSH server
description: Installs the OpenSSH server if missing, enables and starts it, and can open its port in ufw or firewalld.

variables.name: OPEN_FIREWALL
variables.label: Open firewall
variables.help: Allow the SSH port in ufw or firewalld.

name: fail2ban status report
description: Reports whether fail2ban runs, its jails and the banned addresses. Exit 1 when installed but stopped, 3 when not installed.

name: Firewall port
description: Opens, blocks or removes a firewall rule for one TCP or UDP port with ufw or firewalld (the active one first); refuses to block any SSH port. Exit 3 with any other firewall.

name: Firewall status check
description: Reports which firewall is active (ufw, firewalld, nftables, iptables), its default policy and open ports. Exit 1 when nothing filters, 3 when no firewall tool is installed.

name: Mandatory access control report
description: Reports the SELinux and AppArmor state. Exit 2 when none of them is enforcing.

name: Privileged access audit
description: Lists uid 0 accounts, sudo and wheel members, NOPASSWD rules and accounts with an empty password. Exit 1 on an empty password or an extra uid 0 account.

name: SSH configuration audit
description: Checks the effective sshd settings for weak options (root login, password login, empty passwords, weak ciphers and MACs). Exit 2 when weak settings are found.

name: SSH password authentication
description: Shows, disables or enables SSH password login. Disabling is refused unless root or a sudo user has a usable authorized key; sshd -t runs first and the old config is restored on failure.

name: Install packages
description: Installs packages non-interactively with the detected package manager (apt, dnf, yum, zypper, pacman, apk) after refreshing metadata, or reports whether they are installed. Verifies the result.

variables.name: PACKAGES
variables.label: Packages
variables.help: Package names separated by spaces or commas.

name: QEMU guest agent
description: Installs and starts the QEMU guest agent on a KVM/QEMU virtual machine. Exit 3 on physical hosts, containers and other hypervisors.

name: Btrfs device errors check
description: Reads the device error counters of every mounted btrfs filesystem. Exit 1 when any counter is not zero, 3 without btrfs.

name: Largest directories report
description: Lists the largest first-level directories below a path without crossing into other filesystems. Read only, can take a while on large trees.

variables.name: PATH_TO_SCAN
variables.label: Path
variables.help: Absolute directory to scan.

name: LVM thin pool usage check
description: Checks data and metadata usage of LVM thin pools. Exit 2 at the warning level, 1 at the error level, 3 without LVM or thin pools.

variables.name: WARN_PERCENT
variables.label: Warn at or above (%)
variables.help: Pool usage that counts as a warning.

variables.name: ERROR_PERCENT
variables.label: Error at or above (%)
variables.help: Pool usage that counts as a failure.

name: Mounts check
description: Checks that mount points are mounted, writable (a test file is created and removed) unless marked :ro, and answer within 10 seconds, which catches hung network mounts. Exit 1 on any problem.

variables.name: MOUNTS
variables.label: Mount points
variables.help: Absolute paths, add :ro for read-only mounts. One per line or comma separated.

name: Software RAID check
description: Reads /proc/mdstat: exit 1 for a degraded array, 2 while a rebuild or check runs, 3 when no md arrays exist.

name: ZFS pool health check
description: Checks that every imported ZFS pool is ONLINE and shows its fill level. Exit 1 for a degraded or faulted pool, 3 without ZFS.

name: Host name
description: Shows the host name, or sets it and updates /etc/hostname and /etc/hosts.

variables.name: NEW_HOSTNAME
variables.label: New host name
variables.help: Empty only reports the current name.

name: Hosts file entry
description: Adds or removes a managed /etc/hosts entry (marked with # ulrmm). Other lines are never changed.

variables.name: IP
variables.label: IP address
variables.help: Needed for add.

variables.name: ENTRY_HOSTNAME
variables.label: Host name
variables.help: Name to map.

name: Swap file
description: Creates, activates and adds a swap file to /etc/fstab; unchanged when it exists with that size. Refuses file systems that cannot hold swap.

variables.name: SIZE_MB
variables.label: Size (MB)
variables.help: 64 or more.

variables.name: SWAP_PATH
variables.label: File path
variables.help: Absolute path of the swap file.

name: Time synchronisation
description: Makes sure systemd-timesyncd or chrony runs and starts at boot; installs chrony only on request.

variables.name: INSTALL
variables.label: Install chrony
variables.help: Install chrony when no time service exists.

name: Time zone
description: Shows the time zone, or sets it. Exit 3 when the zone is unknown or tzdata is missing.

variables.name: TIMEZONE
variables.label: Time zone
variables.help: For example Europe/Berlin. Empty only reports.

name: Automatic security updates
description: Shows, enables or disables unattended security updates: unattended-upgrades on apt systems, dnf-automatic on dnf systems. Exit 3 on zypper, pacman and apk with the reason.

name: Held packages report
description: Lists packages held back from updates (apt-mark hold, dnf versionlock and exclude, zypper locks, pacman IgnorePkg, apk pins).

name: Add SSH key
description: Adds a public key to a user's authorized_keys after a format check, without duplicates; the file is written as that user, symlinks are refused.

variables.name: TARGET_USER
variables.label: User name
variables.help: Lowercase letters, digits, - and _.

variables.name: PUBLIC_KEY
variables.label: Public key
variables.help: One key line (ssh-ed25519, ssh-rsa, ecdsa); options such as command= are refused.

name: Create user
description: Creates a local user with optional password, sudo rights, SSH key and shell. An existing user is only completed. Passwords are passed to chpasswd on stdin.

variables.name: TARGET_USER
variables.label: User name
variables.help: Lowercase letters, digits, - and _.

variables.name: PASSWORD
variables.label: Password
variables.help: Optional, 8 to 128 characters.

variables.name: SUDO
variables.label: Sudo rights
variables.help: Adds the user to the sudo or wheel group.

variables.name: SSH_PUBLIC_KEY
variables.label: SSH public key
variables.help: Optional, one key line without options.

variables.name: LOGIN_SHELL
variables.label: Shell
variables.help: Optional, default /bin/bash or /bin/sh.

name: Delete user
description: Deletes a local user. Refuses root, system accounts, logged-in users and the last sudo member. The home directory is kept unless asked.

variables.name: TARGET_USER
variables.label: User name
variables.help: Lowercase letters, digits, - and _.

variables.name: REMOVE_HOME
variables.label: Remove home directory
variables.help: Deletes the user's files.

name: Lock or unlock user
description: Locks the password and expires the account (so key logins stop), or reverses it. Refuses root and the last unlocked admin.

variables.name: TARGET_USER
variables.label: User name
variables.help: Lowercase letters, digits, - and _.

name: Set password
description: Sets a local user's password through chpasswd on stdin and checks that the hash changed. Refuses system accounts (root is allowed).

variables.name: TARGET_USER
variables.label: User name
variables.help: Lowercase letters, digits, - and _.

variables.name: PASSWORD
variables.label: Password
variables.help: 8 to 128 characters.

name: SSH keys audit
description: Lists every authorized SSH key per account with size and fingerprint. Exit 2 when DSA or short RSA keys exist, 3 without ssh-keygen.

name: Users list
description: Lists login-capable accounts with groups, locked state, last login and number of SSH keys.

name: AD recycle bin check
description: Checks whether the Active Directory Recycle Bin is enabled in the forest. Exit 1 when not, 3 when not a domain controller.

name: Domain controller replication check
description: Checks replication of this domain controller with its partners. Exit 1 on a failure, 3 when the computer is not a domain controller.

name: Entra ID join status
description: Reports Entra ID (Azure AD), hybrid and on-premises domain join state with tenant and device id from dsregcmd /status.

name: Join domain
description: Joins the computer to an Active Directory domain, optionally into an OU, with an optional restart. The password is never printed. Exit 3 on domain controllers or when already in another domain.

variables.name: DOMAIN
variables.label: Domain
variables.help: DNS or NetBIOS name.

variables.name: DOMAIN_USER
variables.label: Join account
variables.help: For example DOMAIN\admin.

variables.name: OU
variables.label: OU path
variables.help: Distinguished name, for example OU=Servers,DC=corp,DC=example,DC=com.

name: Secure channel check
description: Tests the trust between this computer and its domain, and with REPAIR resets it using the given credentials. Exit 1 when broken, 3 when not domain joined.

variables.name: DOMAIN_USER
variables.label: Domain account
variables.help: Needed for REPAIR.

variables.name: PASSWORD
variables.label: Password
variables.help: Needed for REPAIR.

name: Agent log tail
description: Prints the last lines of the agent log in the agent install directory. Exit 1 when no log file exists, 3 when the agent is not installed.

name: Defender exclusions for the agent
description: Adds Microsoft Defender exclusions for the agent and Mesh Agent directories, the working directory and the agent processes. Exit 3 without Defender cmdlets.

name: MeshCentral agent status
description: Reports the Mesh Agent service state, path and version, and can restart it. Exit 1 when it is not running, 3 when not installed.

name: Antivirus status
description: Lists the antivirus products in Security Center with on/off and signature state. Exit 1 when none is active, 2 when outdated or several are active.

name: Avast Free Antivirus - install
description: Installs Avast Free Antivirus from Avast's offline installer (about 1 GB) with /silent. The switch is not vendor-documented for this product (only for Avast Business), so test on one machine first.
syntax: Checks the Authenticode publisher before running. Refuses when another antivirus is active.

variables.name: INSTALLER_URL
variables.label: Installer URL
variables.help: https URL of a pinned or account-bound installer. The publisher signature is checked the same way.

variables.name: ALLOW_EXISTING
variables.label: Install next to another antivirus
variables.help: Only for migrations: two real-time scanners on one machine cause hangs.

variables.name: TIMEOUT_MINUTES
variables.label: Installer timeout (minutes)
variables.help: The installer is stopped after this time.

name: AVG AntiVirus Free - install
description: Installs AVG AntiVirus Free from AVG's offline installer (about 1.1 GB) with /silent. The switch is not vendor-documented for this product (only for AVG business products), so test on one machine first.
syntax: Checks the Authenticode publisher before running. Refuses when another antivirus is active.

variables.name: INSTALLER_URL
variables.label: Installer URL
variables.help: https URL of a pinned or account-bound installer. The publisher signature is checked the same way.

variables.name: ALLOW_EXISTING
variables.label: Install next to another antivirus
variables.help: Only for migrations: two real-time scanners on one machine cause hangs.

variables.name: TIMEOUT_MINUTES
variables.label: Installer timeout (minutes)
variables.help: The installer is stopped after this time.

name: Bitdefender GravityZone - install
description: Installs the GravityZone security agent through Bitdefender's MSI wrapper for the given installation package; license and policy come from the console.
syntax: Checks the Authenticode publisher before running. Refuses when another antivirus is active.

variables.name: GZ_PACKAGE_ID
variables.label: Installation package ID
variables.help: The text in brackets of setupdownloader_[...].exe from the GravityZone console.

variables.name: INSTALLER_URL
variables.label: Installer URL
variables.help: https URL of a pinned or account-bound installer. The publisher signature is checked the same way.

variables.name: ALLOW_EXISTING
variables.label: Install next to another antivirus
variables.help: Only for migrations: two real-time scanners on one machine cause hangs.

variables.name: TIMEOUT_MINUTES
variables.label: Installer timeout (minutes)
variables.help: The installer is stopped after this time.

name: Bitdefender Total Security - start installer (attended)
description: Starts Bitdefender's setup wizard on the screen of the signed-in user. A person completes it and activates the product by signing in to Bitdefender Central. The account needs administrator rights or an administrator's password for the elevation prompt.
syntax: Run as the signed-in user. Checks the Authenticode publisher before starting and refuses when another antivirus is active. Exit 0 means the wizard was started, not that it finished; run again to confirm.

variables.name: INSTALLER_URL
variables.label: Installer URL
variables.help: https URL of a pinned or account-bound installer. The publisher signature is checked the same way.

variables.name: ALLOW_EXISTING
variables.label: Install next to another antivirus
variables.help: Only for migrations: two real-time scanners on one machine cause hangs.

name: Defender custom scan
description: Scans one folder or file with Microsoft Defender and lists new detections. Exit 1 when something was detected.

variables.name: SCAN_PATH
variables.label: Path to scan
variables.help: Absolute local folder or file, for example C:\Users.

name: Defender enable protection and restore defaults
description: Turns Defender real-time protection on and resets behavior, download and script scanning and cloud protection to defaults. Exclusions stay; policy settings are reported.

name: Defender full scan
description: Runs a Microsoft Defender full scan and lists new detections. Exit 1 when something was detected.

name: Defender quick scan
description: Runs a Microsoft Defender quick scan and lists new detections. Exit 1 when something was detected.

name: Defender signature update
description: Updates the Microsoft Defender signatures now and prints the old and new version.

name: Defender status
description: Checks Microsoft Defender engine, real-time protection and signature age. Passes when another antivirus is the active one.

variables.name: WARN_DAYS
variables.label: Warn at signature age (days)
variables.help: Signature age that counts as a warning.

variables.name: FAIL_DAYS
variables.label: Fail at signature age (days)
variables.help: Signature age that fails the check.

name: ESET command-line scan
description: Scans with ecls.exe of an installed ESET product and lists detections. Exit 1 on threats, 2 when files could not be scanned.

variables.name: SCAN_PATH
variables.label: Path to scan
variables.help: Absolute local path. Empty scans all local drives.

name: ESET Endpoint Antivirus - install
description: Installs ESET Endpoint Antivirus from ESET's MSI with the documented msiexec properties and activates it with the license key if given.
syntax: Checks the Authenticode publisher before running. Refuses when another antivirus is active.

variables.name: LICENSE_KEY
variables.label: License key
variables.help: Activation key, passed to the installer and never printed.

variables.name: INSTALLER_URL
variables.label: Installer URL
variables.help: https URL of a pinned or account-bound installer. The publisher signature is checked the same way.

variables.name: ALLOW_EXISTING
variables.label: Install next to another antivirus
variables.help: Only for migrations: two real-time scanners on one machine cause hangs.

variables.name: TIMEOUT_MINUTES
variables.label: Installer timeout (minutes)
variables.help: The installer is stopped after this time.

name: ESET Endpoint Security - install
description: Installs ESET Endpoint Security from ESET's MSI with the documented msiexec properties and activates it with the license key if given.
syntax: Checks the Authenticode publisher before running. Refuses when another antivirus is active.

variables.name: LICENSE_KEY
variables.label: License key
variables.help: Activation key, passed to the installer and never printed.

variables.name: INSTALLER_URL
variables.label: Installer URL
variables.help: https URL of a pinned or account-bound installer. The publisher signature is checked the same way.

variables.name: ALLOW_EXISTING
variables.label: Install next to another antivirus
variables.help: Only for migrations: two real-time scanners on one machine cause hangs.

variables.name: TIMEOUT_MINUTES
variables.label: Installer timeout (minutes)
variables.help: The installer is stopped after this time.

name: ESET HOME Security and NOD32 - install
description: Installs ESET HOME Security or NOD32 from ESET's offline installer. The silent switches are not vendor-documented, so test on one machine first; activation needs an ESET HOME account in the product.
syntax: Checks the Authenticode publisher before running. Refuses when another antivirus is active.

variables.name: INSTALLER_URL
variables.label: Installer URL
variables.help: https URL of a pinned or account-bound installer. The publisher signature is checked the same way.

variables.name: ALLOW_EXISTING
variables.label: Install next to another antivirus
variables.help: Only for migrations: two real-time scanners on one machine cause hangs.

variables.name: TIMEOUT_MINUTES
variables.label: Installer timeout (minutes)
variables.help: The installer is stopped after this time.

name: ESET HOME Security and NOD32 - start installer (attended)
description: Starts ESET's setup wizard on the screen of the signed-in user. A person completes it and activates the product with the ESET HOME account. The account needs administrator rights or an administrator's password for the elevation prompt.
syntax: Run as the signed-in user. Checks the Authenticode publisher before starting and refuses when another antivirus is active. Exit 0 means the wizard was started, not that it finished; run again to confirm.

variables.name: INSTALLER_URL
variables.label: Installer URL
variables.help: https URL of a pinned or account-bound installer. The publisher signature is checked the same way.

variables.name: ALLOW_EXISTING
variables.label: Install next to another antivirus
variables.help: Only for migrations: two real-time scanners on one machine cause hangs.

name: Kaspersky Endpoint Security - install
description: Installs Kaspersky Endpoint Security for Windows from your hosted distribution kit with the documented EULA and privacy properties.
syntax: Checks the Authenticode publisher before running. Refuses when another antivirus is active.

variables.name: INSTALLER_URL
variables.label: Installer URL
variables.help: https URL of the vendor distribution kit (.exe or .msi) you host. The publisher signature is checked.

variables.name: ALLOW_EXISTING
variables.label: Install next to another antivirus
variables.help: Only for migrations: two real-time scanners on one machine cause hangs.

variables.name: TIMEOUT_MINUTES
variables.label: Installer timeout (minutes)
variables.help: The installer is stopped after this time.

name: Kaspersky Standard / Plus / Premium - install
description: Installs Kaspersky Standard, Plus or Premium (one installer for all three) from the full installer you host, with Kaspersky's documented silent-mode properties, and activates it with the code if given.
syntax: Checks the Authenticode publisher before running. Refuses when another antivirus is active.

variables.name: INSTALLER_URL
variables.label: Installer URL
variables.help: https URL of the full Kaspersky installer you host; Kaspersky publishes no direct link. The publisher signature is checked.

variables.name: BIRTH_DATE
variables.label: Birth date of the device user
variables.help: Kaspersky requires it for a silent install and does not install for users under 16.

variables.name: LICENSE_KEY
variables.label: Activation code
variables.help: Kaspersky activation code, passed to the installer and never printed. Empty leaves activation to the user.

variables.name: ALLOW_EXISTING
variables.label: Install next to another antivirus
variables.help: Only for migrations: two real-time scanners on one machine cause hangs.

variables.name: TIMEOUT_MINUTES
variables.label: Installer timeout (minutes)
variables.help: The installer is stopped after this time.

name: Malwarebytes - install
description: Installs Malwarebytes for Windows; it starts as free or trial and is activated in the product. The silent switches are not vendor-documented, so test on one machine first.
syntax: Checks the Authenticode publisher before running. Refuses when another antivirus is active.

variables.name: INSTALLER_URL
variables.label: Installer URL
variables.help: https URL of a pinned or account-bound installer. The publisher signature is checked the same way.

variables.name: ALLOW_EXISTING
variables.label: Install next to another antivirus
variables.help: Only for migrations: two real-time scanners on one machine cause hangs.

variables.name: TIMEOUT_MINUTES
variables.label: Installer timeout (minutes)
variables.help: The installer is stopped after this time.

name: Memory modules report
description: Lists installed memory modules with slot, size, type, speed, manufacturer, part number and serial, plus the slot count.

name: Monitors report
description: Lists connected monitors with manufacturer, model, serial, manufacture date and size decoded from the display data.

name: OEM product key collector
description: Prints the Windows key embedded in the firmware alone on the last line, or none when there is no OEM key. Exit 0 either way.

name: Serial number collector
description: Prints the hardware serial number alone on the last line for an RMM custom field. Exit 1 when the firmware has no usable serial.

name: System report
description: Prints model, serial, BIOS, OS build, install date, uptime, CPU, RAM, disks and network adapters with their IP addresses.

name: Browser cache clear
description: Clears the cache folders of Chrome, Edge and Firefox in every user profile. A running browser is skipped unless Force is set, which closes it first.

variables.name: BROWSER
variables.label: Browser
variables.help: Which browser to clear.

variables.name: FORCE
variables.label: Close running browser
variables.help: Close the browser if it is running, unsaved work in it is lost.

name: Disk cleanup
description: Removes Windows and user temp files older than a day and the update download cache, optionally empties recycle bins and runs component store cleanup. Reports freed space. Exit 1 if a step failed.

variables.name: DRY_RUN
variables.label: Dry run
variables.help: Only report what would be removed.

variables.name: RECYCLE_BIN
variables.label: Empty recycle bins
variables.help: Also empty the recycle bin of every fixed drive.

variables.name: COMPONENT_CLEANUP
variables.label: Component store cleanup
variables.help: Run DISM StartComponentCleanup (can take several minutes).

name: End process
description: Ends every process with the given name. Core Windows processes and the RMM agents are protected. Exit 0 also when nothing was running.

variables.name: NAME
variables.label: Process name
variables.help: Name with or without .exe.

name: Print spooler reset
description: Stops the print spooler, deletes all queued print jobs and starts the spooler again. Exit 3 where there is no spooler.

name: Restart or shut down
description: Restarts or shuts down the computer after an optional delay with a message for users, or cancels a pending shutdown.

variables.name: MODE
variables.label: Mode
variables.help: What to do.

variables.name: DELAY_MINUTES
variables.label: Delay (minutes)
variables.help: 0 to 1440. Users see the countdown.

variables.name: MESSAGE
variables.label: Message
variables.help: Shown to logged-on users.

variables.name: FORCE
variables.label: Force close applications
variables.help: Close applications without asking, unsaved work is lost. Windows always does so when the delay is above 0.

name: Service control
description: Shows the state and start type of a service, or starts, stops (with dependents) or restarts it. Exit 1 if the service is not in the wanted state.

variables.name: SERVICE
variables.label: Service
variables.help: Service name or display name, no wildcards.

variables.name: ACTION
variables.label: Action
variables.help: What to do.

name: System file repair
description: Checks the component store with DISM and the system files with sfc; repair mode restores both. Exit 0 healthy or repaired, 1 corruption remains.

variables.name: MODE
variables.label: Mode
variables.help: Scan only reports; repair runs DISM RestoreHealth and sfc /scannow.

name: Bluescreen check
description: Looks for bugcheck events and new dump files in the last days. Exit 1 if a bluescreen was recorded.

variables.name: DAYS
variables.label: Look back (days)
variables.help: How far back to look.

name: Process memory check
description: Checks that all instances of a process together stay below a working set limit. Exit 1 above the limit, 0 when not running.

variables.name: PROCESS
variables.label: Process name
variables.help: Name with or without .exe.

variables.name: MAX_MB
variables.label: Maximum memory (MB)
variables.help: Limit for all instances together.

name: Software installed recently report
description: Lists MSI installs, removals and changes of the last hours from the Application log. Programs with their own installer are not recorded there.

variables.name: HOURS
variables.label: Look back (hours)
variables.help: How far back to look.

name: Temporary profile check
description: Detects users on a temporary profile (TEMP folders) and profile registrations ending in .bak. Exit 1 if found.

name: Top processes report
description: Lists the top processes by CPU (measured over 3 seconds, share of the whole machine) or by memory.

variables.name: TOP
variables.label: Processes listed
variables.help: Number of processes.

variables.name: SORT
variables.label: Sort by
variables.help: Ranking.

name: Unexpected shutdown check
description: Looks for Kernel-Power event 41 and EventLog event 6008 in the last days. Exit 1 if an unexpected shutdown was recorded.

variables.name: DAYS
variables.label: Look back (days)
variables.help: How far back to look.

name: Connectivity test
description: Pings hosts, opens TCP connections to host:port targets and resolves a DNS name. Exit 1 if any test fails.

variables.name: TARGETS
variables.label: Targets
variables.help: One per line: host to ping or host:port for a TCP test.

variables.name: DNS_NAME
variables.label: DNS name
variables.help: Name that has to resolve.

name: DNS servers
description: Sets the DNS servers on an adapter (default: the adapters with a default gateway) or returns them to DHCP. Without a server list it only reports.

variables.name: SERVERS
variables.label: DNS servers
variables.help: IP addresses separated by comma, space or line.

variables.name: INTERFACE
variables.label: Adapter name
variables.help: Exact adapter name, empty = adapters with a default gateway.

variables.name: RESET_TO_DHCP
variables.label: Reset to DHCP
variables.help: Use the servers from DHCP, SERVERS is ignored.

name: Firewall rule
description: Adds or removes a Windows Firewall port rule by name. An identical rule counts as done, a rule with the same name and other settings is refused, built-in groups are never removed.

variables.name: ACTION
variables.label: Action
variables.help: What to do.

variables.name: NAME
variables.label: Rule name
variables.help: Display name of the rule.

variables.name: PORT
variables.label: Port
variables.help: Port, range like 8000-8010 or comma list. Needed for add.

variables.name: PROTOCOL
variables.label: Protocol
variables.help: Protocol.

variables.name: DIRECTION
variables.label: Direction
variables.help: Traffic direction.

variables.name: RULE_ACTION
variables.label: Rule action
variables.help: Allow or block.

name: Hosts file entry
description: Adds a host name to the hosts file (replacing an older mapping of the name) or removes it. Already correct entries are left alone.

variables.name: ACTION
variables.label: Action
variables.help: What to do.

variables.name: IP
variables.label: IP address
variables.help: Needed for add.

variables.name: ENTRY_HOSTNAME
variables.label: Host name
variables.help: Name to add or remove.

name: IP configuration report
description: Lists every adapter with an address: status, MAC, IPv4 and IPv6 addresses, gateway, DNS servers and DHCP.

name: Network profile to private
description: Changes connected networks of category Public to Private so file sharing and discovery rules for private networks apply. Domain networks are not touched.

variables.name: INTERFACE
variables.label: Adapter name
variables.help: Exact adapter name, empty = every connection.

name: Network repair
description: Flushes the DNS cache, renews DHCP leases, resets Winsock or resets the TCP/IP stack. The two resets need a restart to finish.

variables.name: ACTION
variables.label: Action
variables.help: What to do.

name: Wi-Fi profiles list
description: Lists saved Wi-Fi profiles with name, authentication, encryption and connection mode. Passwords are never read or shown.

name: Fast startup
description: Shows, enables or disables fast startup (hybrid boot). It only works while hibernation is enabled; a policy value is reported if it overrides the setting.

variables.name: STATE
variables.label: State
variables.help: What to do.

name: Hibernate
description: Shows, enables or disables hibernation. Turning it off removes hiberfil.sys and also disables fast startup.

variables.name: STATE
variables.label: State
variables.help: What to do.

name: Power plan
description: Shows the active power plan or activates Balanced, High performance, Power saver or Ultimate performance; a missing plan is recreated from its template.

variables.name: PLAN
variables.label: Plan
variables.help: Plan to activate.

name: Sleep and display timeouts
description: Sets sleep and display timeouts for AC and battery in the active power plan. Empty values stay unchanged, 0 means never.

variables.name: AC_SLEEP_MINUTES
variables.label: Sleep on AC (min)
variables.help: Empty = unchanged, 0 = never.

variables.name: DC_SLEEP_MINUTES
variables.label: Sleep on battery (min)
variables.help: Empty = unchanged, 0 = never.

variables.name: AC_DISPLAY_MINUTES
variables.label: Display off on AC (min)
variables.help: Empty = unchanged, 0 = never.

variables.name: DC_DISPLAY_MINUTES
variables.label: Display off on battery (min)
variables.help: Empty = unchanged, 0 = never.

name: OpenSSH server
description: Installs the OpenSSH server capability, sets sshd to automatic start and ensures the TCP 22 firewall rule. Needs Windows 10 1809 or Server 2019 and Windows Update access.

name: Remote Desktop
description: Shows, enables or disables Remote Desktop with its firewall rule group, and sets Network Level Authentication when enabling. Exit 1 when a group policy keeps it in the other state, 3 on Home editions.

variables.name: NLA
variables.label: Require NLA
variables.help: Applied when enabling.

name: BitLocker recovery key collector
description: Prints the numerical recovery password of a drive alone on the last line, so an RMM custom field can store it for escrow. Exit 1 when no recovery password exists.

variables.name: DRIVE
variables.label: Drive
variables.help: Drive letter such as C:. Empty means the system drive.

name: BitLocker status check
description: Checks that BitLocker protection is on and the volume is fully encrypted. Exit 1 otherwise, 3 where BitLocker is unavailable (for example Home editions).

variables.name: DRIVE
variables.label: Drive
variables.help: Drive letter such as C:. Empty means the system drive.

name: Enable firewall
description: Turns the Windows Firewall on for all three profiles and reports which profiles were off. Exit 1 when a profile stays off.

name: Failed logons report
description: Groups failed logon events (4625) of the last hours by account and source address. Exit 2 when the count is above the threshold, 3 when the Security log cannot be read.

variables.name: THRESHOLD
variables.label: Warn above
variables.help: Number of failures that raises a warning.

name: Firewall status check
description: Checks that the Windows Firewall is on for the domain, private and public profile. Exit 1 when a profile is off, 3 when the firewall cmdlets are missing.

name: Local administrators audit
description: Lists the members of the built-in Administrators group (found by SID, any language). Exit 1 when a member is not in the ALLOWED list, if one is given.

variables.name: ALLOWED
variables.label: Allowed accounts
variables.help: Accounts that may be administrators, separated by comma or line break. Empty only lists.

name: New user accounts check
description: Lists accounts created in the last hours (event 4720). Exit 2 when any account was created, 0 when none.

name: Pending reboot check
description: Checks the servicing stack, Windows Update, pending file renames and computer rename for a pending restart. Exit 2 when a restart is pending.

name: Secure Boot and TPM report
description: Reports Secure Boot state, UEFI support and TPM presence and readiness. Exit 2 when Secure Boot is off or unsupported or the TPM is missing or inactive.

name: SMBv1 check
description: Reports whether the SMBv1 server protocol is enabled; exit 1 when it is. With DISABLE it turns the protocol and the optional feature off (feature removal needs a restart).

variables.name: DISABLE
variables.label: Disable SMBv1
variables.help: Turn SMBv1 off when it is on.

name: UAC status check
description: Checks that User Account Control is enabled and prints the prompt behaviour and token filter settings. Exit 1 when UAC is disabled.

name: USB storage
description: Shows, enables or disables USB mass storage through the USBSTOR driver start value. Devices already plugged in keep working until removed or restarted.

name: Windows activation check
description: Checks that Windows is activated and prints the product, license channel and grace period. Exit 1 when it is not licensed.

name: Certificate expiry check
description: Checks the certificates of a store for expiry and names the IIS HTTPS bindings that use a listed certificate. Exit 1 expired, 2 expiring soon.

variables.name: WARN_DAYS
variables.label: Warn within (days)
variables.help: Days before expiry that count as a warning.

variables.name: STORE
variables.label: Store
variables.help: Certificate store, for example LocalMachine\My.

name: DHCP scope usage check
description: Checks the address usage of every IPv4 DHCP scope. Exit 2 above the warning level, 1 when a scope is full, 3 without the DHCP role.

variables.name: WARN_PERCENT
variables.label: Warn above (%)
variables.help: Scope usage that counts as a warning.

name: Hyper-V old checkpoints check
description: Lists Hyper-V checkpoints older than the limit. Exit 2 if any exist, 3 without Hyper-V.

variables.name: MAX_DAYS
variables.label: Maximum age (days)
variables.help: Older checkpoints are reported.

name: Hyper-V VM status check
description: Lists Hyper-V VMs with state and heartbeat. Exit 1 if an expected VM is not running, 2 if a VM is critical or paused, 3 without Hyper-V.

variables.name: EXPECT_RUNNING
variables.label: VMs that must run
variables.help: Names, comma or line separated.

name: Windows Server Backup check
description: Checks the last Windows Server Backup run and the age of the last successful backup. Exit 1 if too old, never run or the last run failed, 3 if the feature is missing.

variables.name: MAX_HOURS
variables.label: Maximum age (hours)
variables.help: Age of the last successful backup.

name: Find installed software
description: Lists installed programs (machine-wide, 64-bit and 32-bit entries) with version, publisher and install date, optionally filtered by name. Exit 1 if nothing matches.

variables.name: NAME
variables.label: Name contains
variables.help: Part of the display name, empty lists all.

name: Uninstall software
description: Uninstalls a program by exact display name: MSI with msiexec /x /qn, others only with a QuietUninstallString. Refuses when several entries match.

variables.name: NAME
variables.label: Display name
variables.help: Exact name, see Find installed software.

variables.name: DRY_RUN
variables.label: Dry run
variables.help: Only show the command that would run.

name: Winget
description: Runs winget as SYSTEM in machine scope: list available upgrades, upgrade all, or install, upgrade or uninstall one package by exact id. Exit 3 where winget is not installed (Server 2016/2019, LTSC).

variables.name: ACTION
variables.label: Action
variables.help: list shows packages with an update.

variables.name: PACKAGE_ID
variables.label: Package id
variables.help: Exact id such as Mozilla.Firefox, for install, upgrade and uninstall.

name: Disk space check
description: Checks the used space of fixed drives. Exit 2 above the warning level, 1 above the error level.

variables.name: WARN_PERCENT
variables.label: Warn above (%)
variables.help: Used space that counts as a warning.

variables.name: ERROR_PERCENT
variables.label: Error above (%)
variables.help: Used space that counts as an error.

variables.name: DRIVES
variables.label: Drives
variables.help: Letters like C,D. Empty = all fixed drives.

name: Largest files report
description: Lists the largest files below a folder without following links. Large drives can take several minutes.

variables.name: SEARCH_PATH
variables.label: Folder
variables.help: Local folder, default is the system drive.

variables.name: TOP
variables.label: Files listed
variables.help: Number of files.

variables.name: MIN_MB
variables.label: Minimum size (MB)
variables.help: Smaller files are ignored.

name: Optimize volume
description: Optimizes a volume by media type: retrim for SSDs and thin disks, defragmentation for hard disks.

variables.name: DRIVE
variables.label: Drive letter
variables.help: Default is the system drive.

name: Shadow copies report
description: Lists shadow copies per volume with count, oldest and newest copy, and the shadow storage use and limit.

name: Storage pools health check
description: Checks Storage Spaces pools, virtual disks and pool disks. Exit 2 for a warning, 1 for an unhealthy object, 0 when healthy or no pools exist.

name: Volume scan
description: Scans an NTFS volume for file system errors with Repair-Volume; spot fix repairs offline and may be scheduled for the next restart on the system drive. Exit 1 if errors remain.

variables.name: DRIVE
variables.label: Drive letter
variables.help: For example C.

variables.name: SPOT_FIX
variables.label: Spot fix
variables.help: Repair errors instead of only scanning.

name: Automatic services not running check
description: Lists services set to start automatically that are stopped. Trigger-start services and delayed services shortly after boot are ignored. Exit 1 if any is found.

variables.name: EXCLUDE
variables.label: Exclude
variables.help: Services to ignore, comma or line separated, name or display name, * allowed. The default lists updaters that stop on their own.

name: Event log errors report
description: Lists critical and error events of an event log from the last hours, grouped by provider and event id with count and last message.

variables.name: LOG
variables.label: Log name
variables.help: Event log such as System or Application.

variables.name: HOURS
variables.label: Look back (hours)
variables.help: How far back to look.

variables.name: MAX
variables.label: Groups shown
variables.help: Number of provider/id groups to list.

name: KMS activation
description: Points Windows, Windows Server and volume-licensed Office at your own KMS host and activates them. Can first replace the Windows key with the generic volume license key of the edition. Exit 1 when an activation fails.
syntax: Needs a KMS host you run yourself and matching volume licenses. Store the host once as global key KMS_HOST to reuse it.

variables.name: ACTION
variables.label: Action
variables.help: status only reports the license state, clear removes the stored KMS host.

variables.name: KMS_HOST
variables.label: KMS host
variables.help: Host name or IP, host:port is accepted. The default reads the global key KMS_HOST.

variables.name: KMS_PORT
variables.label: KMS port
variables.help: TCP port of the KMS host.

variables.name: PRODUCTS
variables.label: Products
variables.help: Office means volume-licensed Office, Visio and Project.

variables.name: INSTALL_GVLK
variables.label: Install volume license key
variables.help: Replaces a retail, OEM or MAK key of Windows with the KMS client key of this edition.

name: Long paths enable
description: Sets LongPathsEnabled so applications that declare support can use paths over 260 characters. Needs Windows 10 1607 or Server 2016.

name: Optional feature
description: Shows, enables or disables a Windows optional feature (client, DISM) or a server role or feature. Example: NetFx3 on Windows 10/11 or NET-Framework-Core on Server enables .NET 3.5.
syntax: Client names: Get-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online. Server names: Get-WindowsFeature. .NET 3.5 may need Windows Update or install media.

variables.name: FEATURE
variables.label: Feature name
variables.help: For example NetFx3 (client) or NET-Framework-Core (server).

variables.name: STATE
variables.label: State
variables.help: What to do.

name: Rename computer
description: Renames the computer; the new name is active after a restart. Domain members need domain credentials that may rename the computer object.

variables.name: NEW_NAME
variables.label: New name
variables.help: 1-15 letters, digits or dashes.

variables.name: RESTART
variables.label: Restart in 30 seconds
variables.help: Restart after the rename.

variables.name: DOMAIN_USERNAME
variables.label: Domain user
variables.help: Only for domain members, like DOMAIN\user.

variables.name: DOMAIN_PASSWORD
variables.label: Domain password
variables.help: Only for domain members. Stored in the task history, use a dedicated account.

name: Time sync check
description: Measures the clock offset against the configured time source over SNTP and can resync with w32tm. Exit 1 offset too large, 2 offset could not be measured.

variables.name: MAX_OFFSET_SECONDS
variables.label: Maximum offset (s)
variables.help: Allowed difference to the time source.

variables.name: RESYNC
variables.label: Resync when too large
variables.help: Run w32tm /resync when the offset is above the limit.

name: Time zone
description: Shows the time zone, or sets it by Windows time zone id such as W. Europe Standard Time. Exit 3 for an unknown id.

variables.name: TIMEZONE
variables.label: Time zone id
variables.help: Leave empty to only report.

name: Uptime check
description: Reports the time since the last boot. Exit 2 when it is longer than the limit (a hint that updates wait for a restart).

variables.name: MAX_DAYS
variables.label: Maximum uptime (days)
variables.help: Warn above this.

name: Feature update target
description: Shows, sets or clears the TargetReleaseVersion policy that keeps a Windows 10 or 11 PC on a chosen feature update version. Client Windows only.

variables.name: ACTION
variables.label: Action
variables.help: What to do.

variables.name: PRODUCT
variables.label: Product
variables.help: Windows product the version belongs to.

variables.name: VERSION
variables.label: Version
variables.help: Release such as 24H2 or 22H2, needed for set.

name: Microsoft 365 Apps update
description: Starts an update of Click-to-Run Microsoft 365 Apps with OfficeC2RClient.exe; it continues in the background. Exit 3 if Office is not installed that way.

variables.name: FORCE_CLOSE
variables.label: Close Office apps
variables.help: Close open Office apps so the update does not wait for the user.

name: Restore automatic Windows updates
description: Removes the AUOptions policy value the RMM agent writes when it takes over patching, so Windows manages updates itself again. Other update policies are left alone.

name: Windows 11 readiness check
description: Checks 64-bit CPU, cores, clock, RAM, system disk size, UEFI, Secure Boot capability and TPM 2.0. The CPU model is not checked against Microsoft's list. Exit 1 if a check fails, 3 on Windows Server.

name: Windows Update components reset
description: Stops the update services, renames SoftwareDistribution and catroot2 to .bak, clears the BITS queue and restarts the services. Use when Windows Update is stuck.

name: Create local user
description: Creates a local user and adds it to Users, optionally also to Administrators. The password is never printed. Exit 1 when the account exists or the password policy rejects it.

variables.name: TARGET_USER
variables.label: User name
variables.help: Up to 20 characters.

variables.name: PASSWORD
variables.label: Password
variables.help: Must satisfy the local password policy.

name: Enable or disable local user
description: Enables or disables a local account. Reports when it is already in the wanted state.

name: Local users list
description: Lists local accounts with enabled state, last logon, password expiry and whether they are administrators. Exit 3 on domain controllers.

name: Log off session
description: Logs off all sessions of one user, or of every user with ALL. Unsaved work in those sessions is lost.

variables.name: TARGET_USER
variables.label: User name or ALL
variables.help: Account name, DOMAIN\name, or ALL.

name: Message to logged-on users
description: Shows a message box to every logged-on session with msg.exe. Exit 3 where msg.exe is missing (Home editions), 1 when it reports an error such as no session.

variables.name: MESSAGE
variables.label: Message
variables.help: Up to 500 characters. Double quotes become single quotes.

name: Reset local password
description: Sets a new password on a local account and can force a change at next logon. The password is never printed.

variables.name: PASSWORD
variables.label: New password
variables.help: Must satisfy the local password policy.

variables.name: MUST_CHANGE
variables.label: Must change at next logon
variables.help: Does not work when the password never expires.

name: Sessions list
description: Lists logon sessions (console, remote, disconnected) with user, state, idle time and logon time using the terminal services API.

name: User profiles report
description: Lists user profiles with path, last use and loaded state, optionally the size on disk. Deletes nothing.

variables.name: SIZES
variables.label: Include folder sizes
variables.help: Walks every profile, slow on large ones.

name: Agent log tail
description: Prints the last lines of /var/log/ulrmm-agent.log.

name: Agent services status
description: State of the agent launch daemon, its self-healing job and the MeshCentral agent, with the file paths. Exit 1 when the agent is not running, 2 when the other two are not up.

name: Avast Security - install
description: Installs Avast Security from Avast's online disk image after the Team ID check. System extension and Full Disk Access need the user or MDM.
syntax: Checks pkgutil signature, Team ID and Gatekeeper before installer runs.

name: System report
description: Model, chip, serial, macOS version and build, uptime, memory, storage, IPv4 addresses, battery cycle count and MDM enrollment state.

name: Caches and logs clean
description: Removes old files from system and user caches, /Library/Logs and rotated logs in /var/log. Skips com.apple.* caches and app containers. Dry run by default.

variables.name: DRY_RUN
variables.label: Dry run
variables.help: Only count what would be removed.

variables.name: MAX_AGE_DAYS
variables.label: Older than (days)
variables.help: Only files not modified for this long.

name: Flush DNS cache
description: Flushes the DNS cache and restarts mDNSResponder.

name: Restart or shut down
description: Schedules a restart or shutdown with shutdown(8), shows the message to the console user and can cancel a pending one. A pending shutdown is replaced.

variables.name: MODE
variables.label: Action
variables.help: Restart, shut down, or cancel a pending shutdown.

variables.name: DELAY_MINUTES
variables.label: Delay (minutes)
variables.help: 0 to 1440. 0 means now.

variables.name: MESSAGE
variables.label: Message
variables.help: Shown to the console user. Empty uses a standard text, up to 200 characters.

name: Disk space check
description: Checks the used space of the data volume (APFS container free space, as df reports it). Exit 2 at the warning level, 1 at the error level.

variables.name: WARN_PERCENT
variables.label: Warn above (%)
variables.help: Used space that counts as a warning.

variables.name: ERROR_PERCENT
variables.label: Error above (%)
variables.help: Used space that counts as a failure.

name: Time Machine check
description: Checks that a Time Machine backup exists and is recent. Reads the preferences, falls back to tmutil. Exit 3 when only Full Disk Access would give an answer.

variables.name: MAX_HOURS
variables.label: Max age (hours)
variables.help: Oldest accepted age of the latest backup.

name: Uptime check
description: Fails when the Mac has not been restarted for too long.

variables.name: MAX_DAYS
variables.label: Max uptime (days)
variables.help: Longest accepted time since the last boot.

name: Connectivity test
description: Pings hosts, or opens a TCP connection when a port is given, and optionally resolves a name. Exit 1 when any check fails.

variables.name: TARGETS
variables.label: Targets
variables.help: host or host:port, one per line or comma separated, up to 50.

variables.name: DNS_NAME
variables.label: Name to resolve
variables.help: Optional host name that must resolve.

name: DNS report
description: Resolvers and search domains from scutil --dns plus test lookups. Exit 2 when some lookups fail, 1 when none work or no resolver is set.

name: Wi-Fi report
description: Interface, power, SSID, signal and security of the Wi-Fi link. The SSID is hidden by macOS privacy rules on recent versions and the report says so.

name: Application firewall
description: Shows or sets the application firewall. Exit 1 when it is off in status mode or a change did not take effect (a managed profile can enforce the setting).

variables.name: STATE
variables.label: Action
variables.help: Status only, turn the firewall on, or turn it off.

variables.name: STEALTH
variables.label: Stealth mode
variables.help: With Action on: also turn stealth mode on. Never turns it off.

name: FileVault status
description: Reports whether FileVault disk encryption is on. Exit 0 on, 2 while encrypting or decrypting, 1 off.

name: Remote Login (SSH)
description: Shows or sets Remote Login. Uses systemsetup and falls back to launchctl when the agent lacks Full Disk Access. Exit 1 when the wanted state is not reached.

variables.name: STATE
variables.label: Action
variables.help: Status only, turn Remote Login on, or turn it off.

name: System integrity report
description: Reports SIP, the authenticated root volume and Gatekeeper. Changes nothing. Exit 1 when SIP or Gatekeeper is off, 2 for a custom SIP setup.

name: Command Line Tools install
description: Installs the Command Line Tools through the softwareupdate placeholder method. Does nothing when they are installed.

name: Homebrew outdated report
description: Lists outdated formulae and casks of /opt/homebrew and /usr/local, run as the owner of each installation. Report only, no update.

name: Rosetta install
description: Installs Rosetta 2 on Apple silicon through softwareupdate. Exit 3 on Intel Macs.

name: Computer name
description: Shows or sets ComputerName, LocalHostName and HostName. The host names are reduced to letters, digits and hyphens.

variables.name: NAME
variables.label: New name
variables.help: Empty only reports the current names. Up to 63 characters.

name: Time zone
description: Shows or sets the time zone. Warns when automatic time zone by location is on.

variables.name: TIMEZONE
variables.label: Time zone
variables.help: IANA name such as Europe/Berlin. Empty only reports the current one.

name: Administrator rights
description: Grants or revokes administrator rights of a local user. Refuses to remove the last enabled administrator.

variables.name: TARGET_USER
variables.label: Short name
variables.help: Local account.

variables.name: STATE
variables.label: Action
variables.help: Grant or revoke administrator rights.

name: Console user collector
description: Prints the short name of the user at the screen, or none. The last line is the value.

name: Create user
description: Creates a local user with sysadminctl and reads the password from stdin. The account gets no Secure Token unless it is the first one. Does nothing when the user exists.

variables.name: TARGET_USER
variables.label: Short name
variables.help: Lowercase letters, digits, _ . -, up to 31 characters.

variables.name: FULL_NAME
variables.label: Full name
variables.help: Letters, digits, space and . _ ' -. Empty uses the short name.

variables.name: PASSWORD
variables.label: Password
variables.help: 8 to 128 characters. Visible in the run history of this task.

variables.name: ADMINISTRATOR
variables.label: Administrator
variables.help: Add the user to the admin group.

name: Users list
description: Lists local accounts with UID, admin rights, Secure Token state, disabled flag and last login.

name: Rotate local admin password
description: Rotates the password of a local administrator account and creates it when missing. The password is read from the environment, never printed. Sets the password to never expire.

variables.name: TARGET_USER
variables.label: Account name
variables.help: Local account whose password is rotated, for example ulrmm-admin.

variables.name: NEW_PASSWORD
variables.label: New password
variables.help: 8 to 128 characters, generated by the server.

variables.name: CREATE_IF_MISSING
variables.label: Create the account when missing
variables.help: The new account joins the administrators group.

name: Rotate local admin password
description: Rotates the password of a local administrator account and creates it when missing. Uses chpasswd on stdin; new accounts join sudo or wheel. Refuses locked and system accounts.

variables.name: TARGET_USER
variables.label: Account name
variables.help: Local account whose password is rotated, for example ulrmm-admin.

variables.name: NEW_PASSWORD
variables.label: New password
variables.help: 8 to 128 characters, generated by the server.

variables.name: CREATE_IF_MISSING
variables.label: Create the account when missing
variables.help: The new account joins the administrators group.

name: Rotate local admin password
description: Rotates a local administrator password, creates the account when missing. Secure token caveat: an account holding a secure token may need a token-holding admin, then the rotation fails.

variables.name: TARGET_USER
variables.label: Account name
variables.help: Local account whose password is rotated, for example ulrmm-admin.

variables.name: NEW_PASSWORD
variables.label: New password
variables.help: 8 to 128 characters, generated by the server.

variables.name: CREATE_IF_MISSING
variables.label: Create the account when missing
variables.help: The new account joins the administrators group.
